plot: Saturday noon in the pantry, an hour before apple picking, Dad can't open Mia's new strawberry jam and settles for plain sandwiches, so Lolly rallies the Dough Bros; Bup's one big twist fails while ignored Pim keeps mentioning the lid's 'shiny skirt', and with the car horn honking Zeek realises it's a plastic safety seal Dad never peeled — Lolly cuts it with her star point, the lid pops, Lolly slips into the jam and becomes a jam cookie, Dad thinks he loosened it himself, apple day is saved, and Mia asks if the shiny star cookie can come apple picking too.

script.title: Dad Gave Up on the Jam Jar

beats.say: Dad gave up on the jam? Then we open it. Right now!
M-m-me? Open a jar? Dad has hands. We have crumbs!
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Saturday noon, in the pantry. Apple picking starts at one o'clock.
On the shelf sits Mia's strawberry jam. She picked it herself.
She even drew a little heart on the label.
Dad twisted that lid until his face went red. Nothing.
Then he sighed. Plain bread sandwiches today. Mia's smile just dropped.
Plain bread? On apple day? Not on my shelf. Never.
Okay team, here's the plan. I'm the biggest. I twist.
My calculations say Dad equals about forty Bups. Just saying.
W-wait. Why is the lid wearing a shiny little skirt?
Decoration, Pim. Irrelevant. Focus on the grip.
Bup hugs the lid. He pulls. He grunts. His crust creaks.
The lid doesn't move. Bup slides down the glass like soft butter.
I'm fine. Totally fine. Did somebody just move the floor?
Outside, Dad loads the car. The trunk slams. Thump.
Ten minutes. Then that jar stays shut until next weekend.
Then Mia eats plain bread on her favorite day. Think, everyone.
From the hallway, a tiny voice. Daddy, is my jam open yet?
She sounds so hopeful. I can't hear that again. My bean hurts.
Science time. Air pushes the lid down. That is why it sticks.
Break the seal, and the lid gives up. That's the rule.
Then where is the seal, genius? I see glass. I see metal.
Pim crawls all the way around the jar. Slowly. Squinting.
Th-the skirt again. It's plastic. It wraps the lid like a belt.
Pim, sweetie, nobody wants to hear about the skirt right now.
Beep beep! Dad's car horn. He's coming back for the sandwiches.
Two minutes and we lose apple day. Somebody say something smart!
Wait. Plastic belt. Tiny dotted line. Pim, say that again.
It's a s-skirt. With little holes. Like a tear here line.
That's a safety seal! Dad never took it off!
So the strongest dad in the house was fighting plastic.
Plastic can't be twisted open. It has to be cut. But how?
Excuse me. I am a star. Stars have points.
Lolly presses her sharpest point into the dotted line. Rrrrip.
The plastic belt falls off and spins down to the floor.
I said skirt! I said skirt twice! Nobody listens to the bean!
Okay team. One twist. On three. One, two...
Bup twists. The lid turns like it was waiting all morning.
The smell of strawberries fills the whole pantry. Everyone cheers.
Lolly leans over the rim to see. Her icing slips. Splorch.
She comes up red, shiny, and dripping. A star cookie with jam.
Lolly. You are a cookie filled with jam. You're dessert now.
Strawberry jam cookie. Bakery style. I have never looked better.
Footsteps! The bros dive behind the cereal box just in time.
Dad picks up the jar. The lid spins off in his hand.
Huh, he says. Guess I loosened it after all.
Mia runs in, squealing. Jam sandwiches! Apple day is saved!
Note for the record. The bean solved it. I just explained it.
I solved it? Me? I'm writing that on my bandage.
Then Mia spots a shiny star cookie on the shelf. With jam.
Daddy, she whispers, can the star cookie come apple picking too?
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

"Nobody listens to the bean. Until the bean is right." — Pim
Dad gave up on Mia's strawberry jam an hour before apple picking, so the Dough Bros try to open the jar themselves — and one of them comes out as dessert.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

es.title: Papá se rindió con el frasco de mermelada. Nosotros no 🍓
es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasará en la próxima parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"Nadie escucha al frijol. Hasta que el frijol tiene razón." — Pim
Papá se rindió con la mermelada de fresa de Mia justo antes de ir a recoger manzanas, así que los Dough Bros intentan abrir el frasco ellos mismos… y uno termina convertido en postre.
#serie #Animación3D #DoughBros

pt.title: O papai desistiu do pote de geleia. Nós não 🍓

O papai desistiu da geleia de morango da Mia logo antes de colher maçãs, então os Dough Bros tentam abrir o pote sozinhos… e um deles sai de lá virando sobremesa.
#série #Animação3D #DoughBros

استسلم أبي أمام مربى الفراولة الخاص بميا قبل رحلة قطف التفاح، فيحاول Dough Bros فتح البرطمان بأنفسهم… ويخرج أحدهم منه وقد صار حلوى.
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: Papa a abandonné le pot de confiture. Pas nous 🍓
fr.description:
Selon toi, que se passe-t-il dans la prochaine partie ? Dis-le-moi en commentaire.
« Personne n'écoute le haricot. Jusqu'à ce que le haricot ait raison. » — Pim
Papa abandonne la confiture de fraise de Mia juste avant la cueillette des pommes, alors les Dough Bros essaient d'ouvrir le pot eux-mêmes… et l'un d'eux en ressort transformé en dessert.
#série #Animation3D #DoughBros

りんご狩りの直前、パパはミアのいちごジャムのふたをあきらめた。ドウ・ブロスは自分たちでびんを開けようとするけど…ひとりがデザートになってしまう。
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

"아무도 콩 말을 안 들어. 콩이 맞을 때까지는." — 핌
